data.name: El
data.gender_notes: El is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The meaning of El is recorded in name-lists as “God, Creator”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: El expresses “God, Creator”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of El total 8, reducing to 8. Number 8 is associated with ambition, authority and material mastery.

in_hebrew.name: אל
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The Hebrew word 'El' is a common name for God in the Hebrew Bible. It is derived from the Proto-Semitic root 'il' meaning 'god'. In the Hebrew Bible, the name 'El' is often used in reference to the God of Israel.

in_greek.name: Ελ
in_greek.long_meaning: In Greek, the name 'El' is transliterated from the Hebrew as 'Ελ'. It retains its original meaning of 'God'. In the New Testament, the name 'El' appears in the Septuagint, which is the Greek translation of the Hebrew Bible.

in_latin.name: El
in_latin.long_meaning: In Latin, the name 'El' is transliterated from the Greek as 'El' or from the Hebrew as 'Deus'. It means 'God'. The name 'El' appears in various Latin texts, including in the Vulgate, which is the Latin translation of the Bible.
